headline: Starboard Value Sees Upside in Skyworks Following Proposed Qorvo Merger
summary: Activist investor Starboard Value identified substantial upside potential in Skyworks Solutions following its merger with Qorvo, pointing to targeted cost reductions and profitability gains.
why: Activist investor involvement and large corporate mergers can unlock operational efficiencies, alter cost structures, and drive significant short-term stock price volatility.

impacts.name: Skyworks Solutions
impacts.why: Synergies and cost-reduction plans from a major merger are expected to enhance corporate profitability.
